text: Saudi National Bank's 2025 annual report states 'The ultimate controlling party is the Public Investment Fund "PIF", ultimately owned by the Saudi government', with PIF holding 37.2% (2,234,257,917 shares) at 31 December 2025.
short: PIF is SNB's ultimate controlling party with 37.2%

source.name: Saudi National Bank Annual Report 2025 (corporate governance and financial statements)
